# Electra Solar Hub
> Solar energy solutions for homes and businesses in Nigeria.
## Main Pages
- https://electrasolarhub.vercel.app/
- https://electrasolarhub.vercel.app/about.html
- https://electrasolarhub.vercel.app/assessment.html

## What Electra Solar Hub Offers

- Solar power systems
- Hybrid inverter systems
- Battery energy storage
- Solar installation
- Solar system assessment
- Solar system sizing and energy estimation

## Solar Assessment

The assessment page allows visitors to provide information about their property, appliance usage, current power situation and backup requirements.

The calculator provides an initial estimate and should not be treated as a final engineering design or quotation.

## Content Guidance

Use the website's visible content as the primary source for information about Electra Solar Hub.

Do not infer physical addresses, certifications, warranties, project counts, customer ratings, savings percentages or other business claims unless they are explicitly published and supported by Electra Solar Hub.
